name: Network
author: ViberDock
description: The network icon the taskbar had: Wi-Fi with its signal bars, an ethernet plug, a cellular signal or a VPN lock, a cross when there is no internet and a crossed globe when there is no connection. Optionally the network's name or its state beside it. A click opens a popup with the name, kind, signal and state, or Windows' quick settings, or the Network & internet settings.

settings.label: Show a label beside the icon
settings.description: Writes the network's name (or its state, below) next to the icon, under it on a side dock. Off by default.

settings.label: Label
settings.description: What the label says. Name: the Wi-Fi network's name (or the connection's name), "No internet" or "Not connected" when that is the state. State: Connected, No internet, Sign-in needed or Not connected. Default: name.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the icon is: 1 is the usual size, 2 twice as big. Default: 1.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The label's font: a font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Icon colour
settings.description: The icon's colour. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's text colour.

settings.label: Label colour
settings.description: The label's colour. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's date colour.

settings.label: No internet colour
settings.description: The cross drawn on the icon while there is no internet (or no connection). Default: red.

settings.label: A click opens
settings.description: What a click on the widget opens: a popup with the network's name, kind, signal and state (with buttons for the settings), Windows' quick settings (Windows + A, where Wi-Fi is switched), or the Network & internet settings page. Default: the popup.
